Name: Emily portrait shy_angry bug fix for ohodavis stardewvalley anime mods
Author: Shi777L
Description:
A bug fix for OhoDavi's "stardewvalley anime mods" where Emily 's "shy" expression was replaced with "angry" expression and vice-versa.
this mod consists of a fixed Emily.xnb file that will replace the original for the fix.

Just drag the "Emily.xnb" file to the Content>Portraits folder and replace the old one with this one (make sure to save original just in case).

Mods.ManifestParseErrorText: it's not a SMAPI mod (see https://smapi.io/xnb for info).
